title: Admin dashboard with editable cards
summary: The Admin home page is now a card dashboard. Admins see only the cards their permissions allow, can rearrange or hide them, and the Director can set a shared default layout for new admins.

added: Admin home shows permission-aware cards for help desk queues and SLA, sign-ins, who is clocked in, rota cover, module health, recent admin activity and versions.
Each admin can edit their dashboard layout: move cards with buttons, hide cards, and add them back from a picker that lists only cards they may see.
The Director can save the current layout as the shared default; any admin can reset their layout to that default.
Daily totals store aggregate counts (no individual tracking) for charts such as sign-ins over the last 14 days.
changed: Admin home is a card dashboard instead of a simple link grid.
accessibility: Dashboard layout can be rearranged with Move up and Move down buttons; dragging is not required.

internal_notes: Epic #414. Leaves #438–#443. Two new tables (analytics_daily_totals, admin_dashboard_layouts): Cloudron backup before deploy. Director gate via INTRANET_DIRECTOR_EMAIL. DPIA screening in .github-private docs/apes-intranet/admin-analytics-dpia-screening.md.
